title: Storz & Bickel Acrylic 3 pc Herb Grinder
description:
Storz & Bickel Herb Mill
The Storz & Bickel grinder is 100% acrylic and as far as acrylic grinders go it is one of the best. Besides grinding your herb in preparation for vaporizing it also has a storage compartment in the lid.
Every tooth that is packed into this grinder is extremely sharp and will produce a very consistent grind.
Dimensions
Diameter: 53mm
Includes
﻿1
﻿x S&B Herb Grinder
